blocks.text: Complex ion woh ion hai jis mein beech wala (central) metal apne ird gird ke kai electron dene wale (electron donating) species se juda hota hai.

Central metal ion Lewis acid ka kaam karta hai (electron pair lene wala), jab ke lone pairs (akele electron jore) rakhne wale molecules ya ions, maslan H₂O, NH₃, Cl⁻, OH⁻, Lewis bases ka kaam karte hain. Central metal ion aur electron donors ke darmiyan jitne coordinate bonds bante hain, un ke number ko coordination number kehte hain. Aam coordination numbers 2, 4 aur 6 hain.

Complex ion banna transition metals mein zyada aam hai (kyunke un ke paas bonding ke liye khaali d-orbitals hote hain), lekin Group 2 elements bhi complex ions bana sakte hain, khaas kar group ke upar wale. In ka complex banane ki tendency (rujhan) transition metals se kaafi kam hai, phir bhi kuch jagahon par yeh ahem hai.

Group 2 metal ion complex ion bana sakega ya nahi, yeh us ke size aur charge par depend karta hai. Chhote ions ki charge density zyada hoti hai (charge aur size ka ratio zyada), is liye woh electron dene wale species ko behtar kheenchte hain. Sab Group 2 ions par +2 charge hai, jo electron pair donors ke liye electrostatic attraction (kashish) deta hai.

Jab Group 2 salts paani mein ghulte hain to metal ions hydrate ho jate hain (paani se ghir jate hain). Yeh asal mein complex ions hi hain jin mein paani ke molecules electron pair dete hain. Maslan beryllium Group 2 ka sab se chhota ion hai, is liye us ki charge density zyada hai. Yeh paani ke molecules ko zor se kheenchta hai aur coordination number 4 wala hydrated ion ([Be(H₂O)₄]²⁺) banata hai. Magnesium ions bare hain aur aam taur par hexahydrate (chhe paani wale) complexes banate hain, jin ka coordination number 6 hai ([Mg(H₂O)₆]²⁺).

blocks.alt: Hydrated magnesium ion ka structure (banawat): beech mein Mg aur gird chhe OH2 groups, aik oopar, aik neeche aur chaar ird gird (do hashed bonds se peechhe, do wedge se aage), square brackets ke andar charge 2+ ke saath, aur paas sulphate ion SO4 2-.
blocks.caption: [Mg(H2O)6]2+ aur sulphate ion ka structure (kitab ke be-number structure ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har paani ka molecule apne O atom ka ek lone pair Mg²⁺ ko deta hai, is liye chhe coordinate bonds bante hain aur coordination number 6 hai; shakal octahedral hai. Hashed bond kaghaz ke peechhe aur wedge bond kaghaz se aage hai. Bracket ke bahar 2+ poore complex ion ka charge hai, aur SO₄²⁻ saath wala anion hai jo charge barabar karta hai.
Ca²⁺, Sr²⁺ aur Ba²⁺ jaise bare ions bhi hydrated ions banate hain, zyada tar coordination number 6 ke saath, lekin group mein neeche yeh attraction kamzor hoti jati hai.

Group 2 ions, khaas kar chhote, aise donors ke saath stable complexes bana sakte hain jin ke paas dene ke liye ek se zyada electron pairs hon. Aise species ek hi metal ion se ek se zyada coordinate bonds bana kar ring (halqe) jaisa structure banate hain.
Calcium ion chhe electron pairs dene wale EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) ke saath ek complex ring structure banata hai.

Yeh complex banna water softening (sakht paani ko narm karne) mein istemal hota hai, jahan EDTA sakht paani se Ca²⁺ aur Mg²⁺ ions nikal deta hai. EDTA se jism se zehreele metal ions bhi nikale ja sakte hain (kabhi kabhi Ca²⁺ bhi, agar us ka level (miqdar) bohat zyada ho).
Tasveer ke neeche likha hai: Ca-EDTA complex dawaiyon (medicines) mein istemal hota hai taake jism se metal ions nikale ja sakein.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Complex ion = beech mein metal ion (electron pair lene wala) + ird gird donors (electron pair dene wale, jaise H₂O). EDTA ek hi molecule hai jo chhe jagahon se Ca²⁺ ko pakad leta hai, jaise kekra (crab) apne panjon se; is liye yeh complex bohat mazboot hai.

blocks.prompt: a) MgSO₄ BaSO₄ ke muqable mein aasani se kyun ghulta hai?
blocks.explanation: Sulphate ion bara hai, is liye Mg se Ba tak lattice enthalpy thori hi badalti hai. Lekin chhota Mg²⁺ paani ko zor se kheenchta hai aur us ki hydration enthalpy bohat zyada negative hai, jo lattice torne ki energy poori kar deti hai. Bare Ba²⁺ ki hydration enthalpy kaafi kam negative hai, is liye BaSO₄ nahi ghulta.

blocks.prompt: b) Lattice energy Group 2 sulphates ki solubility par kaise asar karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Ghulne ke liye lattice energy deni parti hai. Bare sulphate ion ki wajah se group mein neeche lattice energy bohat thori kam hoti hai, jab ke hydration enthalpy zyada kam hoti hai. Is liye lattice torne ki energy ka bojh neeche wale sulphates ke liye bhaari parta hai aur un ki solubility kam hoti jati hai (MgSO₄ 1.83 × 10⁻¹ se BaSO₄ 9.43 × 10⁻⁷ mol/100 g).

blocks.prompt: c) Kaun sa hydroxide zyada ghulta hai: Ca(OH)₂ ya Sr(OH)₂? Wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: Sr(OH)₂ (3.4 × 10⁻³ mol/100 g, jab ke Ca(OH)₂ 1.5 × 10⁻³). Hydroxides mein group ke neeche lattice enthalpy hydration enthalpy se zyada kam hoti hai, is liye Sr(OH)₂ aasani se ghulta hai.

items: Complex ion: central metal ion (Lewis acid) + electron pair donors (Lewis bases); coordination number = coordinate bonds ka number.
[Be(H₂O)₄]²⁺ (4) aur [Mg(H₂O)₆]²⁺ (6); chhote ions behtar complexes banate hain.
Ca²⁺ + EDTA⁴⁻ → [Ca(EDTA)]²⁻: paani narm karna aur jism se zehreele metal ions nikalna.
